new_value: InMemoryCache::prune_expired(now) drops entries whose nextUpdate has passed and returns the count; crl_len/ocsp_len/len/is_empty make growth observable; clear drops everything. Entries without nextUpdate are kept, since the cache documents that as 'never expires until invalidated' -- the wrappers never store one anyway. The caller supplies now for the same reason get_crl does no freshness filtering: the authoritative time is the caller's now_unix, not the wall clock. Nothing is scheduled; this type spawns no threads. Type docs now also state what bounds the key space, which is better than 'unbounded' suggests: entries are stored only after a determinative verdict, so the source was signature-verified and growth is bounded by what real CAs and responders will sign, not by what a peer can send. Boundary pinned: nextUpdate == now is expired. Commit 7899cad6.
